race.comment: BRUTAL EMPIRE (7) looks hard to beat. Has started here at both runs this time in, finding one better each time. Gets chance to break through. EQUIVASTER (4) showed early speed from an outside draw and held a forward position before fading to finish fifth, beaten 4 lengths, last start over 1150m at this track. Finally draws a gate and looks a danger. PENINSULA ROSE (5) is a former Victorian who ran on well first try for the new yard here. Better for that and should be tough to stop late. MIDWAY POINT (2) was seventh but beaten just over a length second-up. Blinkers added and worth following up. DEER POWER (8) is a three-year-old gelding lining up for debut and was an effortless trial winner here. Watch closely on that.
